acceptanceCriteria.text: Queue stores remaining raid count and boss candidates with selected first target
Winning and returning consumes one candidate and starts the next without searching while candidates remain
Recoverable create errors skip the failed boss; exhaustion triggers one new search
Loss, insufficient World Energy, or zero remaining raids stops dispatch
Stop queue clears pending candidates and leaves an already active rally running
Focused regression tests and full project check pass

checkpointPayload.description: Persist the boss candidates from one search, consume them across wins and recoverable errors, search again only when candidates are exhausted, and stop on loss, insufficient World Energy, zero remaining wins or user cancellation.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: Inspect existing state machine and energy cache; implement persisted boss queue and next-target transitions; update cancel semantics and UI status; test win/error/exhaustion/energy/stop and build.
checkpointPayload.title: Use searched boss list for sequential raid queue
